## Standards — PASS
The source stays within the existing lifecycle runner and uses its write-once metadata pattern. The guide adds a focused explanation; no unnecessary command or framework was introduced. I found no material maintainability blocker.

## Spec — PASS
The parent and baseline show the intended gap: host loss left the attempt `unknown` without identifying its direct child. The change adds a durable child identity and nested read-only observation while keeping the attempt `unknown` when the host is absent. The verifier asserts live and exited child observations, same-ID relaunch refusal, preserved records/work, and malformed-identity failures. Descendant cessation and recovery authorization remain explicitly unclaimed.

Static review only; I did not run the verifier or processes.
